messages.subject: Adding loess line
parts:
I made a nice scatter plot with 4 factors and smoothed loess-lines for
each factor.
Now i want to add (on the same plot) a smoothed line for all the data
and not per factor.

How do I do that? Haven't been able to find a solution in the forum
etc.

Code below

> q <- qplot(data=QCdata,date,logKonc, colour=factor(Bruger), fill=factor(Bruger), alpha=0.5)
> p1 <- q + stat_smooth(method="loess", size=1.5)
> p1

Thanks,
Kristian

messages.author: 68b661fcb57b94a9
messages.subject: Re: Adding loess line
parts:
Hey,

You can just add another geom_smooth(aes(group=1)). Or add geom_smooth(aes(colour=NULL)).
